top_signals.title: South Korea Reviewing Military Options for Hormuz
top_signals.summary: South Korea is reviewing options, including military measures, to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, the presidential office said on Friday, while denying media reports that the government had already decided on a deployment.Several South Korean media outlets…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CFTC files to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
top_signals.summary: The CFTC’s lawyers called the lawsuit “much ado about nothing,“ claiming that the CME Group lacked standing to file and argued against its claims over crypto perpetual futures.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
